observations: Ten bidders with seeded plus/minus-twenty errors around value one hundred produced twenty winning bids averaging 116.5, all over value; displayed overall guess average 99.2.
Two-bidder preset lowered average winner to 105.4; twenty-bidder preset raised it to 118.6.
Screenshot shows individual guesses and highlighted highest value in each auction against the true-value line.
Reveal retains ten- and two-bidder evidence and explains selection of the largest error, explicitly naming made-up seeded guesses.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Separate average estimate from average selected maximum.

whyCool: Winning is itself evidence that your estimate may be the unusually optimistic one.
caveat: Seeded common-value toy with bids equal guesses; no strategic bid shading or private-value auction analysis. Guess-average display stayed 99.2 across tested presets.
effort: Prediction, twenty auctions at ten bidders, two- and twenty-bidder contrasts, screenshot and reveal.
